verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official CLI (nitropy) and Python SDK that can configure/manage devices programmatically, confirmed to install and run via PyPI, but there is no formal REST/OpenAPI interface (all API endpoint probes 404) and no explicit vendor claim of full UI/CLI feature parity for AI-native automation. Missing for 10: documented API/OpenAPI spec, explicit parity statement between GUI app and nitropy CLI, and independent verification that all UI-exposed features are scriptable via nitropy.
